questions.rationale: In the order C1 through C6, C3 comes immediately before C4, placing it directly to the left. C5 is to the right of C4, not the left. C2 is two cells to the left of C4, not adjacent. C6 is at the far right end.

questions.stem: A facility map shows a central corridor running north to south. The Medical Unit is at the north end of the corridor and the Laundry is at the south end. If an officer walks from the Medical Unit toward the Laundry, in which cardinal direction is the officer traveling?
options: East
North
South
West
questions.rationale: The Medical Unit is at the north end and the Laundry is at the south end, so moving from Medical toward Laundry means heading south. North would move the officer away from the Laundry, back toward Medical. East and West are perpendicular to the north-south corridor and would not lead toward the Laundry.

questions.stem: On the Westbrook Jail map, the Visitation Room and the Chaplain's Office sit directly across a hallway from each other. The Visitation Room is on the north side of the hallway. On which side of the hallway is the Chaplain's Office?
options: North side
East end
West end
South side
questions.rationale: If two rooms are directly across a hallway and one is on the north side, the other must be on the south side. It cannot also be on the north side, since they are on opposite sides of the same hallway. The east and west ends describe the ends of the corridor, not the sides where facing rooms sit.

questions.stem: The recreation yard at Pinewood Correctional is a square. The Weight Area is in the northwest corner and the Basketball Court is in the northeast corner. An officer standing at the Weight Area wants to reach the Basketball Court by walking straight along the north edge of the yard. In which direction does the officer walk?
options: West
North
South
East
questions.rationale: Both areas are on the north edge, with the Weight Area at the northwest corner and the Basketball Court at the northeast corner. Moving from a west corner to an east corner means walking east. West would move away from the Basketball Court. South and North would leave the north edge entirely.

questions.stem: In the intake area, three desks are arranged in a single row. The Warrant Check desk is to the left of the ID Verification desk, and the ID Verification desk is to the left of the Photo desk. Which desk is in the middle?
options: Warrant Check
ID Verification
Photo
None of them
questions.rationale: The order from left to right is Warrant Check, then ID Verification, then Photo, so ID Verification sits in the middle. Warrant Check is on the far left, and Photo is on the far right. The row clearly has a middle desk, so 'None of them' is incorrect.

questions.stem: A floor plan shows a straight hallway with the Control Room at the far west end and the Sally Port at the far east end. An officer at the Sally Port needs to reach the Control Room by walking straight down the hallway. Which direction does the officer travel?
options: South
East
North
West
questions.rationale: The Control Room is at the west end and the Sally Port is at the east end. Traveling from east to west means heading west. East would move the officer farther from the Control Room. North and South are perpendicular to this east-west hallway.

questions.stem: On a housing unit map, cells are numbered along a row: 201, 202, 203, 204, 205. Cell 203 is directly across the dayroom from cell 210 on the opposite row. Which cell is directly to the right of 203?
questions.rationale: In the sequence 201 through 205, cell 204 comes immediately after 203, making it the cell directly to the right. Cell 202 is to the left of 203. Cell 210 is across the dayroom, not to the right in the same row. Cell 205 is two positions to the right, not adjacent.

questions.stem: The administration building has a lobby at the center. The Warden's Office is directly north of the lobby, and the Records Room is directly south of the lobby. An officer leaves the Warden's Office and walks through the lobby to the Records Room. In which cardinal direction is the officer walking?
options: South
East
North
West
questions.rationale: The Warden's Office is north of the lobby and the Records Room is south of it, so moving from Warden's Office through the lobby to Records means traveling south. North would head back toward the Warden's Office. East and West are perpendicular and would not reach the Records Room.

questions.stem: In a single straight corridor, four doors appear in this left-to-right order: Kitchen, Dining Hall, Pantry, Freezer. Which door is at the far right end of the corridor?
options: Dining Hall
Kitchen
Pantry
Freezer
questions.rationale: Reading left to right, Freezer is listed last, so it is at the far right end. Kitchen is at the far left. Dining Hall and Pantry are in the middle. Only the last item in a left-to-right list occupies the far right position.

questions.stem: A map of Cedar Hollow Jail shows a T-shaped hallway. The Armory is at the top of the T (north) and the Break Room is at the bottom of the T's vertical stem (south). To go from the Break Room straight up to the junction, which direction must an officer walk?
options: East
North
South
West
questions.rationale: The Break Room is at the south end of the vertical stem and the junction is above it toward the north. Walking 'straight up' toward the junction means heading north. South would move away from the junction. East and West run along the top bar of the T, not the vertical stem.

questions.stem: In a row of offices, the Sergeant's Office is immediately to the left of the Lieutenant's Office, and the Captain's Office is immediately to the right of the Lieutenant's Office. Which office is between the other two?
options: Lieutenant's Office
Sergeant's Office
They are all separate
Captain's Office
questions.rationale: The Sergeant is to the left of the Lieutenant and the Captain is to the right of the Lieutenant, so the order is Sergeant, Lieutenant, Captain. The Lieutenant's Office sits between the other two. The Sergeant's and Captain's Offices are the outer offices, not the middle one.

questions.stem: At Redwood Correctional Facility, the shift supervisor lists which rooms are directly adjacent to the Central Control booth. The booth's north wall connects to the Staff Lounge, its east wall connects to the Equipment Room, its south wall connects to a solid exterior wall, and its west wall connects to the Elevator Lobby. Select ALL rooms that are directly adjacent to (share a wall with) Central Control.
options: Elevator Lobby
Equipment Room
Visitation Hall
Rooftop Yard
Staff Lounge
questions.rationale: Central Control shares its north wall with the Staff Lounge, its east wall with the Equipment Room, and its west wall with the Elevator Lobby, so all three are directly adjacent. The south wall is a solid exterior wall with no room, and the Visitation Hall and Rooftop Yard are never listed as sharing any wall with Central Control.

questions.stem: The main floor of the Westgate Correctional Facility is laid out on a grid. The Control Center is at the middle of the floor. The Visitation Room is two rooms directly north of the Control Center, and the Commissary is one room directly east of the Visitation Room. Starting at the Control Center, which set of moves brings an officer to the Commissary?
options: One room east, then two rooms north
One room north, then two rooms east
Two rooms north, then one room east
Two rooms south, then one room west
questions.rationale: The Visitation Room is two rooms north of the Control Center, and the Commissary is one room east of Visitation, so the path is two north then one east. Going south or west heads away from both rooms, and 'one east then two north' would not land on the Commissary, which is offset only one room east of a point two rooms north.

questions.stem: Officer Nguyen must complete a security round in this exact order: start at the Sally Port, then the North Tower, then the Recreation Yard, then the Medical Wing, and finish back at the Sally Port. She has already checked the North Tower and the Recreation Yard. Which location must she check NEXT?
options: The Sally Port to finish
The North Tower again
The Recreation Yard again
The Medical Wing
questions.rationale: The route order is Sally Port, North Tower, Recreation Yard, Medical Wing, Sally Port. Having done the North Tower and Recreation Yard, the next stop is the Medical Wing, which comes before the final return to the Sally Port. The North Tower and Recreation Yard are already complete.

questions.stem: On the map of the Lakeshore Facility, north is up. The Intake Building is at the southwest corner. The Kitchen is directly north of Intake, and the Cafeteria is directly east of the Kitchen. From the Cafeteria, in which direction is the Intake Building?
options: Northwest
Southwest
Southeast
Northeast
questions.rationale: Intake is south of the Kitchen, and the Kitchen is west of the Cafeteria, so from the Cafeteria the Intake Building lies both to the south and to the west, that is, southwest. Northeast would be the reverse direction, and the other diagonals mix up one correct axis with one wrong one.

questions.stem: In Housing Unit D of the Crestline Jail, cells line both sides of a central corridor that runs north-south. On the east side, from north to south, are Cells D1, D2, D3, and D4. On the west side, directly across from those cells, are Cells D5, D6, D7, and D8 in the same north-to-south order. Which cell is directly ACROSS the corridor from Cell D3?
options: Cell D8
Cell D2
Cell D6
Cell D7
questions.rationale: D3 is the third cell from the north on the east side, so its across-the-corridor counterpart is the third west-side cell from the north, which is D7. D5 pairs with D1, D6 with D2, and D8 with D4, so none of those align with D3. D2 is on the same (east) side, not across.

questions.stem: A visitor to the Millbrook Correctional Center is given directions from the parking lot: 'Face the main building. Walk to the entrance, go inside, and take the first left. Follow that hall to its end and the Visitor Check-In is on your right.' The visitor faces the building heading east and enters heading east. After taking the first left, which direction is the visitor walking?
options: South
East
North
West
questions.rationale: Heading east and turning left rotates you 90 degrees counterclockwise to face north. Turning right instead would face south, staying straight remains east, and a west heading would require a reverse turn.

questions.stem: The floor plan of the Oakdale Annex shows a T-shaped hallway. The vertical stem of the T runs north-south, and the horizontal top of the T runs east-west along the north edge. The Armory is at the north end of the vertical stem, where it meets the horizontal hall. At the west end of the horizontal hall is the Control Room, and at the east end is the Property Room. An officer walking north up the vertical stem reaches the top and turns to head toward the Property Room. Which way does she turn?
options: Left
She continues straight north
Right
She turns around
questions.rationale: Walking north and needing to reach the Property Room at the east end, she must head east, which is a right turn when facing north. A left turn would take her west toward the Control Room, continuing straight is impossible at the top of the T, and turning around sends her back south.

questions.stem: Officer Palmer's assigned patrol is: begin at the Front Desk, proceed to the Law Library, then to the Barber Shop, then to the Laundry, and end at the Loading Dock. If she is currently at the Barber Shop, how many stops remain before she finishes her patrol (not counting her current stop)?
options: Three
One
Two
Four
questions.rationale: After the Barber Shop, the remaining stops are the Laundry and the Loading Dock, which is two stops. The Front Desk and Law Library have already been visited, and only two locations come after the current one.

questions.stem: At the Sterling Correctional Facility, an inmate is described in a report as being housed in 'the cell in the northeast corner of the housing unit, on the upper tier.' The unit has two tiers, upper and lower, and four corners. Which single cell does this description identify?
options: The upper-tier cell in the northeast corner
The upper-tier cell in the northwest corner
The lower-tier cell in the southeast corner
The lower-tier cell in the northeast corner
questions.rationale: The description specifies both the northeast corner and the upper tier, which uniquely identifies the upper-tier northeast corner cell. The lower-tier northeast cell has the correct corner but wrong tier, and the northwest and southeast options are in the wrong corners entirely.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: The Fairhaven Facility map shows a square perimeter road with a guard tower at each corner: Tower A (northwest), Tower B (northeast), Tower C (southeast), and Tower D (southwest). An officer drives clockwise around the perimeter road starting at Tower A. Which tower does she reach SECOND?
options: Tower A again
Tower C
Tower D
Tower B
questions.rationale: Driving clockwise from the northwest corner (Tower A) goes east along the top edge first, reaching Tower B (northeast) as the second tower. Tower C would be third and Tower D fourth on a clockwise loop; returning to Tower A would only happen after all four.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: In the Redwood Jail, the Control Booth sits at the hub of four wings that extend like spokes: A-Wing points north, B-Wing points east, C-Wing points south, and D-Wing points west. Officer Cole is at the far end of A-Wing and must reach the far end of B-Wing. The only path is back to the Control Booth and out along another wing. From the Control Booth, in which direction must she travel to reach the end of B-Wing?
options: West
East
South
North
questions.rationale: B-Wing points east from the Control Booth, so from the hub she must travel east to reach the far end of B-Wing. North leads back into A-Wing, south into C-Wing, and west into D-Wing.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: A dispatch note reads: 'The disturbance is in the room that is directly south of the Gymnasium and directly west of the Dining Hall.' On the floor plan, the Gymnasium is at the north-center, the Dining Hall is at the mid-east, and the Weight Room is at the mid-center, south of the Gymnasium and west of the Dining Hall. Which room is the disturbance in?
options: The Dining Hall
The Gymnasium
The Weight Room
The room north of the Gymnasium
questions.rationale: The Weight Room is the only room that is both south of the Gymnasium and west of the Dining Hall, matching the dispatch exactly. The Gymnasium and Dining Hall are the reference points named in the note, not the target, and no room north of the Gymnasium fits the two-part description.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: The Northpoint Facility corridor runs east-west. Along the south wall, from west to east, are the Classroom, the Counseling Office, and the Nurse's Station. Along the north wall, directly across from each south room in the same order, are the Storage Room, the Records Room, and the Supervisor's Office. Officer Bell stands facing north, directly in front of the Counseling Office. Which room is directly in front of her across the corridor?
options: The Records Room
The Supervisor's Office
The Storage Room
The Nurse's Station
questions.rationale: The Counseling Office is the middle south room, and the north-wall rooms are paired in the same west-to-east order, so the Records Room (the middle north room) is directly across from it. The Storage Room aligns with the Classroom, and the Supervisor's Office aligns with the Nurse's Station. The Nurse's Station is on the same south wall, not across.

questions.stem: Officer Ramos receives directions to a fire alarm: 'From the Control Room, go north to the end of the corridor, turn right, and it's the second door on your left.' The corridor runs north-south. After Officer Ramos turns right at the end, the doors on her left are on which side of that new hallway?
options: The north side
The east side
The south side
The west side
questions.rationale: After heading north and turning right, Officer Ramos faces east; her left side then points north, so the doors on her left are on the north side of the east-west hallway. The south side would be to her right, and east and west are ahead and behind her, not to her sides.

questions.stem: The Silvercreek Correctional Center has three cell blocks arranged in a row from west to east: Block Alpha, Block Bravo, and Block Charlie. The Central Control is a hub south of Block Bravo, connected to each block by a corridor. To move an inmate from Block Alpha to Block Charlie, an officer must pass through Central Control. Which block does the officer's path pass nearest to at the Central Control hub?
options: Block Bravo
Block Charlie
Block Alpha
None; the hub is far from all blocks
questions.rationale: Central Control is located directly south of Block Bravo, the middle block, so the hub is nearest to Block Bravo. Blocks Alpha and Charlie are the outer blocks on the west and east ends, farther from the centrally placed hub.

questions.stem: At the Brookhaven Jail, the security patrol must visit these points strictly in order: the Sally Port, the Kitchen, the Chapel, the Yard, and the Infirmary. Which TWO of the following statements about the patrol order are TRUE?
options: The Chapel is the last stop
The Kitchen is visited before the Chapel
The Sally Port is visited after the Kitchen
The Infirmary is the first stop
The Yard is visited immediately after the Chapel
questions.rationale: In the order Sally Port, Kitchen, Chapel, Yard, Infirmary, the Kitchen does come before the Chapel and the Yard does come immediately after the Chapel, so both of those are true. The Infirmary is last (not first), the Sally Port is first (not after the Kitchen), and the Yard, not the Chapel, is fourth while the Infirmary is last.

questions.stem: On the Grandview Facility map, the Main Gate is at the south edge and a single central road runs straight north to the Administration Building at the north edge. Halfway up this road, a branch road goes east to the Warehouse. An officer entering at the Main Gate wants the shortest drive to the Warehouse. What should the officer do?
options: Drive all the way north to Administration, then turn east
Drive north to the halfway point, then turn west
Drive east immediately from the Main Gate
Drive north to the halfway point, then turn east
questions.rationale: The branch road to the Warehouse leaves the central road at the halfway point and heads east, so the shortest path is north to that point then east. Continuing all the way to Administration overshoots the branch, turning west goes the wrong direction, and there is no road heading east directly from the Main Gate.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: In the Elmwood Detention Center, an inmate roster lists a cell as 'Tier 2, third cell from the stairs, on the window side.' The stairs are at the east end of Tier 2, cells are numbered starting from the stairs, and the window side is the north wall. Reading from the stairs, cells on the window side are W1, W2, W3, and W4. Which cell is described?
options: W4
W2
W3
W1
questions.rationale: Counting from the stairs on the window side, the third cell is W3, matching 'third cell from the stairs, window side.' W1 is the first cell, W2 the second, and W4 the fourth, so only W3 fits the description.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: The visiting area of the Templeton Facility is a long room divided into eight booths in a single row, numbered 1 through 8 from the entrance. Booth 1 is nearest the entrance. An officer is told to escort a visitor to 'the booth just before the halfway point of the row.' Which booth is that?
options: Booth 4
Booth 5
Booth 8
Booth 3
questions.rationale: With eight booths, the halfway point falls between Booths 4 and 5, so the booth just before the halfway point is Booth 4. Booth 3 is one booth too early, Booth 5 is just after the halfway point, and Booth 8 is the far end of the row.

questions.stem: At the Vargas Reception Center, the main hallway runs east-west with rooms opening off both sides. On the north side, from west to east, are: Sally Port, Intake Desk, Property, and Showers. On the south side, each room sits directly across from a north-side room in the same order: Waiting, Booking, Storage, and Uniform Issue. Which room is directly across the hall from Property?
options: Waiting
Booking
Storage
Uniform Issue
questions.rationale: Property is third from the west on the north side, and the south-side rooms match the same order, so the third south-side room, Storage, sits directly across from Property. Waiting is across from the Sally Port, Booking is across from the Intake Desk, and Uniform Issue is across from the Showers.

questions.stem: Officer Reyes starts at the Central Control Booth. She walks north 40 feet to a junction, turns east and walks 30 feet to a second junction, then turns south and walks 40 feet. Relative to her starting point at the Central Control Booth, where is she now?
options: 40 feet north of the booth
30 feet west of the booth
Back at the booth
30 feet east of the booth
questions.rationale: The 40 feet north and the 40 feet south cancel out, leaving only the 30 feet traveled east, so she ends up 30 feet east of the booth. She is not west, the north/south segments offset each other so she is not 40 feet north, and she has not returned to the exact start because of the eastward leg.

questions.stem: A facility map shows a rectangular corridor loop. Starting at the northwest corner and walking clockwise, an officer passes the Library, then the Gymnasium, then the Chapel, then the Commissary before returning to the start. If the officer instead walks counterclockwise from the northwest corner, which location does the officer reach first?
options: Chapel
Commissary
Library
Gymnasium
questions.rationale: Clockwise order is Library, Gymnasium, Chapel, Commissary, so the last one reached clockwise, the Commissary, is the first one reached going counterclockwise. The Library is reached last counterclockwise, and the Gymnasium and Chapel fall in the middle of the reversed sequence.

questions.stem: On a grid map of the Colfax Annex, corridors run only north-south and east-west, and each block is one unit. The Armory is at grid point (2, 5) and the Loading Dock is at grid point (6, 2), where the first number is the east position and the second is the north position. Traveling only along corridors, what is the shortest distance in units from the Armory to the Loading Dock?
options: 3 units
7 units
9 units
5 units
questions.rationale: The east difference is 6 minus 2 = 4 units and the north difference is 5 minus 2 = 3 units, and along grid corridors the shortest path is 4 + 3 = 7 units. Three and 5 undercount the combined horizontal and vertical travel, and 9 overcounts it.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: Directions to the Disciplinary Hearing Room read: 'From the Officer's Lounge, exit and turn left. Walk to the end of the hall and turn right. The room is the second door on your left.' The Officer's Lounge door opens facing south. After the first left turn, which cardinal direction is the officer walking?
options: East
South
West
North
questions.rationale: Facing south and turning left points you east, because a left turn is 90 degrees counterclockwise from a southward facing. North would be the reverse direction, west would be a right turn, and south would mean no turn was made.

questions.stem: The Brookhaven Jail floor plan shows three pods branching off a central hub. Pod A is to the north of the hub, Pod B is to the southeast, and Pod C is to the southwest. An officer in Pod B needs to reach Pod C by passing through the hub. From Pod B, which general direction leads back to the hub, and then which direction leads on to Pod C?
options: Northwest to the hub, then southwest to Pod C
North to the hub, then south to Pod C
Northeast to the hub, then southeast to Pod C
Southwest to the hub, then northwest to Pod C
questions.rationale: Pod B is southeast of the hub, so returning to the hub means heading northwest, and Pod C is southwest of the hub, so continuing to Pod C means heading southwest. The other options reverse the direction back to the hub or misplace Pod C relative to the hub.

questions.stem: In the Sentinel Ridge staff wing, six adjacent lockers stand in a row labeled left to right: L1, L2, L3, L4, L5, L6. Officer Cho's locker is two to the right of L2. Officer Blake's locker is immediately to the left of L6. Which locker is directly between Officer Cho's locker and Officer Blake's locker?
options: L5
There is no locker between them
L4
L3
questions.rationale: Two to the right of L2 is L4 (Cho), and immediately left of L6 is L5 (Blake), so the locker between L4 and L5 is none directly, but re-reading: between L4 and L5 there is no gap. Correction: Cho at L4 and Blake at L5 are adjacent, leaving nothing between—however the intended reading places Cho at L4 and Blake at L5 with no locker between, so the between-locker must be reconsidered. Because L4 and L5 are adjacent, the choice 'L4' is incorrect and the answer is that there is no locker between them.

questions.stem: Officer Tran must patrol four checkpoints in the shortest total distance, starting and ending at the Guard Station. On the map, the Guard Station is at the center. Checkpoint 1 is 20 feet north, Checkpoint 2 is 20 feet south, Checkpoint 3 is 20 feet east, and Checkpoint 4 is 20 feet west, each connected to the station by a spoke corridor with no direct links between checkpoints. What is the shortest total distance to visit all four checkpoints and return to the Guard Station?
options: 200 feet
80 feet
120 feet
160 feet
questions.rationale: Each checkpoint requires going out 20 feet and back 20 feet along its spoke, which is 40 feet per checkpoint, and four checkpoints total 4 times 40 = 160 feet. 80 feet counts only one-way trips, 120 feet omits one round trip, and 200 feet overcounts the spokes.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: A map is drawn with north at the top. Officer Ellis reports that the Segregation Unit is 'up and to the right' of the Central Yard, meaning it is both above it and to its right on the map. Which single cardinal or intercardinal direction best describes the Segregation Unit's location relative to the Central Yard?
options: Southwest
Northwest
Southeast
Northeast
questions.rationale: On a north-up map, 'up' is north and 'to the right' is east, so up and to the right combine to northeast. Northwest would be up and left, southeast would be down and right, and southwest would be down and left.

questions.stem: The description reads: 'The target room has a window on its west wall, is directly north of the Boiler Room, is immediately east of the Electrical Closet, and shares its south wall with the Boiler Room.' On the floor plan, four rooms are candidates. Room W is north of the Boiler Room and east of the Electrical Closet. Room X is south of the Boiler Room. Room Y is west of the Electrical Closet. Room Z is east of the Boiler Room. Which room matches the description?
options: Room W
Room X
Room Z
Room Y
questions.rationale: Only Room W is both directly north of the Boiler Room and immediately east of the Electrical Closet, matching the description. Room X is on the wrong side of the Boiler Room, Room Y is on the wrong side of the Electrical Closet, and Room Z is east of the Boiler Room rather than north of it.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: Officer Santos walks a route: east 50 feet, then north 30 feet, then west 50 feet, then south 30 feet. Which statement about the route is true?
options: The route ends east of the start
The route forms a rectangle and returns to the starting point
The route ends north of the start
The route ends 60 feet from the start
questions.rationale: The east and west legs (50 each) cancel and the north and south legs (30 each) cancel, tracing a closed rectangle back to the start. The route does not end away from the start, so it is not 60 feet away, not north of, and not east of the starting point.

questions.stem: On the Kestrel Unit floor plan, the central corridor runs north-south. Along the east side of the corridor, from north to south, are the Nurse Station, the Pharmacy, and the Exam Room. Along the west side, directly across from each, are Records, the Waiting Area, and Triage. Select ALL statements that are correct.
options: The Nurse Station is directly across from Records
The Exam Room is north of the Pharmacy
Triage is directly across from the Exam Room
The Pharmacy is directly across the corridor from the Waiting Area
Records is on the east side of the corridor
questions.rationale: The east-side rooms map to the west-side rooms in the same north-to-south order, so Pharmacy is across from Waiting Area, Nurse Station is across from Records, and Exam Room is across from Triage—all correct. The Exam Room is south (not north) of the Pharmacy, and Records is on the west side (not east), so those two statements are wrong.

questions.stem: A patrol officer at Fairmont Correctional must visit the Rec Yard, the Chow Hall, and the Chapel in an order that never backtracks along the single east-west main corridor. On the corridor, from west to east, the order of these three is: Rec Yard, Chapel, Chow Hall. Starting from the west end, what is the correct west-to-east visiting order with no backtracking?
options: Rec Yard, Chapel, Chow Hall
Rec Yard, Chow Hall, Chapel
Chapel, Rec Yard, Chow Hall
Chow Hall, Chapel, Rec Yard
questions.rationale: Visiting them in their physical west-to-east order, Rec Yard then Chapel then Chow Hall, means always moving east with no backtracking. Every other option requires reversing direction at some point along the corridor.

questions.stem: The floor plan of the Delmar Work Center shows the Tool Crib in the northwest corner. The Assembly Bay is directly south of the Tool Crib. The Paint Booth is directly east of the Assembly Bay. Which corner of the building is the Paint Booth closest to?
options: Northwest corner
Northeast corner
Southwest corner
Southeast corner
questions.rationale: Starting from the northwest Tool Crib, going south to the Assembly Bay and then east to the Paint Booth places the Paint Booth toward the south and east, nearest the southeast corner. The northwest is the starting corner, and the northeast and southwest corners each miss one of the two movements taken.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: Officer Whitfield is facing west while standing at the Sally Port. She makes a right turn, walks forward, then makes another right turn. After both right turns, in which cardinal direction is she facing?
options: West
East
South
North
questions.rationale: Facing west and turning right points north, and a second right turn from north points east, so she ends up facing east. West would mean no net turn, north is only after the first turn, and south would require a left turn or a different combination.

questions.stem: On a grid map, cells are laid out in blocks. From the Control Post, Cell Block G is reached by going 3 blocks east and 4 blocks north. Cell Block H is reached from the same Control Post by going 3 blocks east and 1 block north. Which cell block is closer to the Control Post by grid-corridor distance?
options: Cell Block G
Cannot be determined
They are equally close
Cell Block H
questions.rationale: Cell Block H is 3 + 1 = 4 blocks away while Cell Block G is 3 + 4 = 7 blocks away, so Cell Block H is closer. They are not equal, and the distances are fully determined by the given grid movements.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: A visitor is told: 'Enter through the north lobby, which faces you as you come in. Go straight, take the first hallway on your right, and the Visitation Desk is at the end.' If the lobby entrance faces south (so entering, you walk north), which cardinal direction does the visitor turn onto for the first hallway on the right?
options: East
North
South
West
questions.rationale: Walking north and turning right leads to the east, since a right turn from a northward heading is 90 degrees clockwise to the east. West would be a left turn, south would be a reversal, and north would mean continuing straight.

questions.stem: The Rowan County Jail map shows a T-shaped corridor. The vertical stem runs north-south and the horizontal top runs east-west. The Intake is at the south end of the stem. Where the stem meets the top, the Booking Office is to the west and the Holding Tank is to the east. To reach the Holding Tank from Intake, an officer walks north up the stem and then turns which way at the T-junction?
options: Left (west)
Back (south)
Straight (north)
Right (east)
questions.rationale: Walking north up the stem, the officer faces north at the junction, and the Holding Tank is to the east, which is a right turn. Left would lead to the Booking Office in the west, straight is blocked at the top of the T, and going back returns toward Intake.

questions.stem: Harlan State Prison's Cell Block D is a rectangular grid. Officer Reyes stands at the northwest corner cell. She walks 4 cells south, then 3 cells east, then 2 cells north. Relative to her starting cell, where is she now?
options: 4 cells south and 3 cells west
6 cells south and 3 cells east
2 cells south and 3 cells east
2 cells north and 3 cells east
questions.rationale: Moving 4 south then 2 north nets 2 cells south, and the 3 east has no offsetting movement, leaving her 2 south and 3 east of start. The second option ignores that south (4) exceeds north (2). The third adds south and north instead of subtracting, and the fourth wrongly reports the east-west direction as west.

questions.stem: At Beaumont Detention, two parallel north-south corridors (West Corridor and East Corridor) are joined by a single east-west crossover hallway in the middle. The Law Library is at the north end of the West Corridor. The Commissary is at the south end of the East Corridor. Officer Cole is at the Law Library. What is the shortest route to the Commissary?
options: Go north to the crossover, then east and south
Go east directly to the Commissary
Go south down the West Corridor past the crossover to its south end, then east
Go south down the West Corridor to the crossover, east across to the East Corridor, then south to the Commissary
questions.rationale: From the north end of the West Corridor the only link to the East Corridor is the middle crossover, so she goes south to the crossover, east across it, then south to the Commissary. The second route has no crossover at the south end, so it cannot reach the East Corridor. The third route goes north, away from the crossover. The fourth is impossible because the two corridors are only joined at the crossover, not directly.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: The Silverton Jail floor plan shows a central atrium. Directly north of the atrium is Administration; directly south is the Kitchen; directly east is the Gym; directly west is the Chapel. The Records Office sits in the corner between Administration and the Gym. In which corner of the building is the Records Office?
options: Northeast
Southwest
Southeast
Northwest
questions.rationale: Administration is north and the Gym is east, so the corner between them is the northeast corner. Northwest would be between Administration and the Chapel (west). Southeast would be between the Kitchen and Gym, and Southwest between the Kitchen and Chapel, none of which matches.

questions.stem: Officer Tan receives radio directions at Montrose Correctional: 'From the East Gate, head west along Perimeter Road to the third building on your left, then enter and go to the far end.' Perimeter Road runs east-west, and traveling west the buildings on the left (south side) are, in order, Warehouse, Motor Pool, and Training Annex. Which building should Officer Tan enter?
options: Training Annex
Motor Pool
Warehouse
East Gate guardhouse
questions.rationale: Heading west, the third building on the left is the Training Annex, since the order is Warehouse (first), Motor Pool (second), Training Annex (third). The Warehouse and Motor Pool are the first and second buildings, not the third. The East Gate guardhouse is the starting point, not a numbered building on the left.

questions.stem: At Delmont Jail a single main hallway runs east-west with side rooms. From the Control Room an officer must reach the Storage Room. Route A: 40 feet east, then a side passage 30 feet south to Storage. Route B: 20 feet west, then 50 feet south, then 60 feet east to Storage. Both routes end at the same Storage Room. Which route is shorter?
options: Route A, at 70 feet
Route B, at 130 feet
Both are equal
Route A, at 40 feet
questions.rationale: Route A totals 40 plus 30 equals 70 feet, while Route B totals 20 plus 50 plus 60 equals 130 feet, so Route A is shorter at 70 feet. The second option correctly totals Route B but labels the longer route as the answer to 'shorter.' They are not equal, and Route A is 70 feet, not 40 feet, since the southern leg must be included.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: Ravenscroft Detention has an L-shaped corridor. The vertical part runs north-south; the horizontal part runs east-west and joins the bottom (south end) of the vertical part, extending east. The Booking desk is at the north end of the vertical part. The Cafeteria is at the east end of the horizontal part. Walking from Booking to the Cafeteria along the corridor, which directions does the officer travel, in order?
options: North, then east
South, then east
South, then west
East, then south
questions.rationale: From Booking at the north end the officer walks south down the vertical corridor to the corner, then east along the horizontal corridor to the Cafeteria, so the order is south then east. North would move away from the corner. 'East then south' reverses the two legs. 'South then west' would head away from the Cafeteria, which is to the east.

questions.stem: The Oakmoor Facility map shows Housing Units arranged around a central Rec Yard: Unit 1 north of the yard, Unit 2 east, Unit 3 south, Unit 4 west. A walkway loops around all four units. Officer Baird is at Unit 1 and must deliver mail to Unit 3, which is on the opposite side. Cutting straight across the Rec Yard is prohibited. Going clockwise around the loop, which unit does she pass on the way?
options: Unit 4
No units
Unit 2 then Unit 4
Unit 2
questions.rationale: Clockwise from Unit 1 (north) the next unit is Unit 2 (east), then Unit 3 (south), so she passes Unit 2 before reaching Unit 3. Unit 4 (west) would be passed only if she went counterclockwise. She does not pass both units, because Unit 3 is reached after just one intermediate unit. She must pass at least one unit since crossing the yard is prohibited.

questions.stem: At Cranfield Prison, an officer at the South Gate is told: 'Walk north 200 feet to the flagpole, turn right and walk 100 feet, then turn left and walk 150 feet. The Infirmary is on your right.' After the first turn, which cardinal direction is the officer walking?
options: South
East
West
North
questions.rationale: Walking north and then turning right means turning to the east, so after the first turn the officer heads east. A left turn from north would have been west. The officer is no longer heading north after the turn, and south would be a full reversal, which a single right turn does not produce.

questions.stem: Whitlock Jail's map uses a grid where each square is 25 feet. The Guard Station is at grid point (2, 2) and the Segregation Unit is at grid point (5, 6), where the first number is squares east and the second is squares north. How many total squares of straight-line grid movement (east plus north) separate them, and what is that in feet?
options: 7 squares, 175 feet
9 squares, 225 feet
5 squares, 125 feet
7 squares, 350 feet
questions.rationale: The east difference is 5 minus 2 equals 3 squares and the north difference is 6 minus 2 equals 4 squares, totaling 7 squares, which at 25 feet each is 175 feet. The second option undercounts the squares. The third uses the correct 7 squares but multiplies by 50 instead of 25. The fourth adds the coordinates incorrectly.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: Bellhaven Detention has a T-shaped corridor. The stem of the T runs north-south with the Lobby at the south (bottom) end. The top of the T runs east-west, with the Visitation Room at its west end and the Attorney Room at its east end. From the Lobby, an officer walks north to the junction, then must choose a direction for the Attorney Room. Which way should he turn?
options: Continue north
Turn left (west)
Turn around (south)
Turn right (east)
questions.rationale: Arriving from the south and facing north at the junction, the Attorney Room at the east end is to the officer's right, so he turns right (east). Turning left (west) would lead to the Visitation Room. Continuing north is impossible because the stem ends at the junction, and turning around heads back to the Lobby.

questions.stem: The Northgate Correctional yard map shows the Sally Port in the southwest corner and the Watchtower in the northeast corner. A diagonal service road connects them directly. If an officer drives from the Sally Port to the Watchtower along this road, in which general compass direction is she heading?
options: Southwest
Northeast
Northwest
Southeast
questions.rationale: Traveling from the southwest corner to the northeast corner means moving both north and east, which is the northeast direction. Northwest would require moving west, not east. Southeast and Southwest both require moving south, but she is moving north.

questions.stem: At Ironwood Prison the cellblock has two floors connected by a stairwell at the west end. On the first floor, walking east from the stairwell, the cells are 101, 102, 103, 104. The second floor mirrors this with 201, 202, 203, 204 in the same east positions. Officer Kim is at cell 103 and must go to cell 202. What is the most direct route?
options: Walk west to the stairwell, go up to the second floor, then walk east to 202
Walk east to the stairwell, go up, then walk west to 202
Walk west to 101, up the stairs, east to 202
Go up through the ceiling directly above 103
questions.rationale: The stairwell is at the west end, so from 103 she walks west to the stairwell, climbs to the second floor, then walks east to 202. The second option places the stairwell at the east end, which is incorrect. The third takes an unnecessary detour all the way to 101 before the stairwell. There is no direct vertical passage through the ceiling.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: Dunmore Jail's map shows a rectangular building with the long side running east-west. The Control Center is at the exact center. The Nurse's Office is halfway between the Control Center and the east wall. The Pharmacy is just past the Nurse's Office, closer to the east wall. Starting at the Control Center, which room does an officer reach first walking east, and which is farther?
options: Nurse's Office first, Pharmacy farther
Pharmacy first, Nurse's Office farther
Both at the same distance
Neither is to the east
questions.rationale: The Nurse's Office is halfway to the east wall and the Pharmacy is just past it toward the wall, so walking east the officer reaches the Nurse's Office first and the Pharmacy is farther. The second option reverses their order. They are not at the same distance, and both are clearly to the east of the Control Center.

questions.stem: Officer Salazar is at Post 3 in the Vaughn Facility exercise yard. She is told: 'Face the north fence. The equipment shed is at your ten o'clock; the water station is at your two o'clock.' Treating twelve o'clock as straight ahead (north), which compass direction is roughly toward the water station?
options: Southeast
Southwest
Northeast
Northwest
questions.rationale: Facing north, two o'clock is to the front-right, which corresponds roughly to the northeast direction. Northwest would be around ten o'clock, where the equipment shed is. Southeast and Southwest are behind the officer (toward four to eight o'clock) and do not match the two o'clock position.

questions.stem: The Larkspur Detention map shows three connected wings forming a U-shape opening to the north: the West Wing runs north-south on the left, the East Wing runs north-south on the right, and the South Wing connects their south ends running east-west. The Kitchen is at the north end of the West Wing. The Laundry is at the north end of the East Wing. Cutting through the open north side is not allowed. Which route connects the Kitchen to the Laundry?
options: South down the West Wing, east along the South Wing, north up the East Wing
North across the open end directly to the Laundry
South down the West Wing, then south again
East directly across from the Kitchen to the Laundry
questions.rationale: Because the north side is open and cannot be crossed, the officer must go south down the West Wing, east along the connecting South Wing, then north up the East Wing to the Laundry. Crossing the open north end directly is prohibited. There is no direct east corridor at the north ends. The fourth option repeats south and never turns toward the East Wing.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: At Foxglen Prison an officer follows these directions from the Front Desk: 'Go straight (north) 50 feet, turn left, go 40 feet, turn left again, go 20 feet.' Assume the Front Desk faces north. After completing all three legs, which cardinal direction is the officer now facing?
options: North
East
South
West
questions.rationale: Starting facing north, a left turn faces west, and a second left turn from west faces south, so the officer ends up facing south. North was only the starting direction. East would require right turns. West was the facing after the first turn only, not the final facing.

questions.stem: Redcliff Jail's map has a grid of hallways. The Mailroom is 3 blocks east and 2 blocks north of the Sally Port. Each block is the same length. An officer must travel only along hallways (no diagonals). Which of these is a valid shortest path, using the fewest blocks?
options: North 3 blocks, then east 2 blocks (5 blocks)
East 3 blocks, north 2 blocks, then west 1 block (6 blocks)
East 3 blocks, then north 2 blocks (5 blocks)
Diagonal straight line (about 3.6 blocks)
questions.rationale: The shortest hallway path covers exactly the required 3 east and 2 north, totaling 5 blocks, and 'east 3, north 2' does this. The second option adds an unnecessary west block, making 6. The third moves the wrong amounts (3 north, 2 east) and would not reach the Mailroom. A diagonal is not allowed since travel must follow hallways.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: The Ashford Facility map shows a circular perimeter road with four gates evenly spaced: North Gate at the top, East Gate on the right, South Gate at the bottom, West Gate on the left. An officer at the North Gate drives counterclockwise around the perimeter. Which gate does she reach first?
options: West Gate
North Gate again
East Gate
South Gate
questions.rationale: Counterclockwise from the North Gate (top) the road curves toward the left side, reaching the West Gate first. The East Gate would be first if she drove clockwise. The South Gate is two gates away in either direction, and returning to the North Gate would require a full loop.

questions.stem: At Fenwick Correctional, the second-floor plan is a rectangle. Along the north wall, from west to east, are Rooms 201, 202, and 203. Along the south wall, directly across from them, are Rooms 204, 205, and 206 respectively (204 across from 201, and so on). An officer stands in Room 202 and needs the room diagonally opposite, at the southeast area of that block. Which room is it?
options: Room 203
Room 205
Room 206
Room 204
questions.rationale: Room 202 is the middle north room; the southeast corner of the three-by-two block is Room 206 (south wall, east end), which is diagonally opposite the northwest area, but among the south rooms it is the one to the east and across, making it the diagonal from 202 toward the southeast. Room 205 is directly across (south), not diagonal. Room 204 is southwest, the opposite diagonal. Room 203 is on the north wall, not south.

questions.stem: A patrol route at Grantham Prison must visit five posts in a fixed clockwise loop that starts at Post A (north), then goes to Post B (east), Post C (south), Post D (west), and back toward Post A. The officer is currently at Post C after having come from Post B. If she reverses direction and now travels counterclockwise, which post does she reach next?
options: Post B
Post A
Post E
Post D
questions.rationale: The clockwise order is A, B, C, D; reversing to counterclockwise from Post C sends her back the way she came, to Post B. Post D is the next clockwise post, not counterclockwise. Post A is two steps back counterclockwise. Post E is not part of the four-post loop described.

questions.stem: The Oakmere Unit map shows a T-shaped corridor. The top bar of the T runs east-west, and the stem runs south from the center of the bar. The Infirmary is at the west end of the top bar, the Classroom is at the east end, and the Sally Port is at the south end of the stem. An officer at the Infirmary must reach the Sally Port using corridors only. Which sequence of directions is correct?
options: Go east to the T-junction, then south to the Sally Port
Go east all the way to the Classroom, then south
Go south, then east to the Sally Port
Go west to the T-junction, then south to the Sally Port
questions.rationale: The Infirmary is at the west end, so the officer travels east along the top bar to the central junction, then turns south down the stem to the Sally Port. Going west leads away from the junction to a dead end. Going south first is impossible because the stem only connects at the center. Continuing to the Classroom overshoots the junction where the stem begins.

questions.stem: In the Sable Ridge intake wing, four holding cells sit in a two-by-two grid. Cell H1 is northwest, H2 is northeast, H3 is southwest, and H4 is southeast. An officer describes an incident: 'The disturbance was in the cell south of H2 and east of H3.' Which cell is being described?
options: H2
H4
H1
H3
questions.rationale: The cell south of H2 (northeast) is the southeast cell, and the cell east of H3 (southwest) is also the southeast cell; both descriptions point to H4. H1 is northwest, matching neither clue. H2 and H3 are the reference cells themselves, not the described location.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: The Whitmore Facility parking map shows the Staff Lot northwest of the main building and the Transport Bay southeast of the main building. A transport van leaves the Transport Bay and drives in a straight line toward the Staff Lot, passing through the building's location. In which direction is the van traveling?
options: Southeast
Northeast
Northwest
Southwest
questions.rationale: Traveling from a southeast point toward a northwest point means heading northwest. Southeast would be the reverse direction, back toward the bay. Northeast and southwest are perpendicular diagonals that do not connect these two locations.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: At Cliffton Jail, an officer begins a round facing north at the Control Booth. His route is: walk forward 40 feet, turn right and walk 30 feet, turn right again and walk 40 feet, then turn right and walk 30 feet. Where does he end up relative to the Control Booth?
options: 40 feet north of the booth
Back at the Control Booth
30 feet east of the booth
40 feet south of the booth
questions.rationale: The path forms a closed rectangle: 40 north, 30 east, 40 south, 30 west, returning to the start. He is back at the Control Booth. The three-turn cancellation means no net displacement, so the other options, which imply leftover distance in one direction, are incorrect.

questions.stem: The Rowan Correctional map labels housing pods with letters. Pod A is at the far north. Directly south of A is Pod B. Directly south of B is Pod C. The Dining Hall lies directly east of Pod B. An officer in the Dining Hall wants to reach Pod A by the shortest path. Which single combined direction best describes the straight-line route?
options: Northeast
Southwest
Northwest
Due west
questions.rationale: Pod A is north of Pod B, and the Dining Hall is east of Pod B, so Pod A lies to the north and west of the Dining Hall, giving a northwest straight-line direction. Northeast and southwest point away from Pod A's actual position. Due west would only reach Pod B, not the more northern Pod A.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: A patrol at Marsh Hollow Prison must check posts in this order: Gate 1, Yard, Gate 2, Kitchen, Gate 3. Policy requires that after every gate check the officer immediately logs the time before moving on. The officer has logged times for Gate 1 and Gate 2 but not for Gate 3. Which non-gate area has definitely been checked already?
options: Only the Yard
Only the Kitchen
Both the Yard and the Kitchen
Neither the Yard nor the Kitchen
questions.rationale: Gate 2 has been logged, which means the officer reached the fourth stop, so the Yard (before Gate 2) and the Kitchen (after Gate 2, before Gate 3) fall in the sequence up to the current point; since Gate 3 is not yet logged but Gate 2 is, the Kitchen between them must have been passed en route to attempting Gate 3. Thus both the Yard and Kitchen are done. 'Only the Yard' ignores the Kitchen reached after Gate 2. 'Only the Kitchen' ignores the earlier Yard. 'Neither' contradicts the completed Gate 2 log.

questions.stem: The Templeton Unit floor plan is a square divided into four equal quadrants by a north-south corridor and an east-west corridor that cross at the center. The Laundry occupies the northeast quadrant, the Gym the northwest, the Chapel the southwest, and the Clinic the southeast. An officer walks the east-west corridor from the west edge to the center, then turns to walk the north-south corridor toward the south edge. Which two quadrants border the corridor segment she walks after turning?
options: Laundry and Gym
Gym and Chapel
Laundry and Clinic
Chapel and Clinic
questions.rationale: After turning south at the center, she walks the southern half of the north-south corridor, which is bordered by the two southern quadrants: the Chapel (southwest) and the Clinic (southeast). The Laundry and Gym are northern quadrants, not adjacent to the southern corridor segment. Mixed pairs like Gym-Chapel or Laundry-Clinic span north and south, so they do not both border the south segment.

questions.stem: On the Brackenford map, the Visitor Entrance is at the south end of a long north-south driveway. Halfway up the driveway, a branch road turns off to the east leading to the Sally Port. Continuing north to the top of the driveway is the Admin Building. A delivery driver at the Sally Port needs to reach the Admin Building. Which route is correct?
options: Go east farther, then north to Admin
Go south to the Visitor Entrance, then north
Go north directly from the Sally Port to Admin
Go west back to the driveway, then north to Admin
questions.rationale: The Sally Port branch runs east off the driveway, so the driver returns west to the driveway, then heads north to the Admin Building at the top. Going 'north directly' is impossible because the only connecting road returns to the driveway first. Going south to the Visitor Entrance moves the wrong way. Going farther east leads away from both the driveway and Admin.

questions.stem: At Verdant Hills Jail, five cells line the north side of a hallway, numbered west to east: 11, 12, 13, 14, 15. An officer's log reads: 'Contraband found two cells east of Cell 11, and again in the cell immediately west of Cell 15.' Which cells are named in the log?
options: Cells 13 and 15
Cells 12 and 13
Cells 13 and 14
Cells 12 and 14
questions.rationale: Two cells east of Cell 11 is Cell 13 (11 to 12 to 13). The cell immediately west of Cell 15 is Cell 14. So the log names Cells 13 and 14. Cell 12 is only one cell east of 11, not two. Cell 15 is the reference cell, not the one west of it.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: The Kestrel Facility has a security checkpoint map. An officer standing at the North Gate faces the interior yard, which lies to the south. She is told the Weapons Locker is 'on her right as she looks into the yard.' Given her orientation, in which compass direction is the Weapons Locker?
options: East
South
West
North
questions.rationale: Facing south, the officer's right hand points west, so the Weapons Locker is to the west. Her left would be east. North is behind her and south is straight ahead, neither of which is 'on her right.'
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: A patrol officer at Aldergate Prison must check the Rec Yard, Law Library, Commissary, and Medical in an order that satisfies: Medical is checked last; the Rec Yard is checked immediately before the Commissary; and the Law Library is checked first. What is the full correct order?
options: Law Library, Rec Yard, Commissary, Medical
Law Library, Rec Yard, Medical, Commissary
Rec Yard, Commissary, Law Library, Medical
Law Library, Commissary, Rec Yard, Medical
questions.rationale: Law Library is first and Medical is last, and Rec Yard must come immediately before Commissary; placing Rec Yard second and Commissary third satisfies all rules: Law Library, Rec Yard, Commissary, Medical. The second option breaks the Rec-Yard-before-Commissary rule. The third puts Law Library third, not first. The fourth puts Medical third, not last.

questions.stem: The Halloway Unit map shows a hexagonal control hub with six doors, one on each side, labeled clockwise starting from the top: North Door, Northeast Door, Southeast Door, South Door, Southwest Door, Northwest Door. An officer enters through the South Door and wants to exit through the door directly opposite. Which door is that?
options: Southeast Door
Northwest Door
North Door
Northeast Door
questions.rationale: On a regular hexagon, the door directly across from the South Door is the North Door. The Northeast and Northwest doors are adjacent-to-opposite, offset by one position each. The Southeast Door is next to the South Door, not opposite it.

questions.stem: At Bracken Court Jail, the map scale is 1 centimeter to 8 meters. Two watchtowers are drawn 5 centimeters apart on the map. An officer needs to know if a 45-meter cable will reach between them. Based on the scale, what is the real distance and will the cable reach?
options: 40 meters; the cable does not reach
45 meters; exactly reaches
48 meters; the cable does not reach
40 meters; the cable reaches
questions.rationale: Five centimeters at 8 meters each equals 5 x 8 = 40 meters, which is less than 45 meters, so the cable reaches. The option saying 40 meters does not reach is wrong because 45 exceeds 40. The 45-meter and 48-meter distances miscalculate the scale conversion.

questions.stem: The Southgate Annex ground floor has a central rotunda with three corridors radiating out. Corridor 1 goes due north to Housing. Corridor 2 goes due southeast to Intake. Corridor 3 goes due southwest to the Kitchen. An officer leaves Housing, walks to the rotunda, and takes the corridor that heads southeast. Where does he arrive?
options: Intake
Housing
Kitchen
The rotunda only
questions.rationale: The southeast corridor is Corridor 2, which leads to Intake. Housing is reached by the north corridor he just left. The Kitchen is on the southwest corridor, the opposite diagonal. He passes through the rotunda but continues on to Intake, so 'rotunda only' is incorrect.

questions.stem: In the Torrance Facility, the second floor is drawn on the map rotated so that the top of the page points east instead of north (a north arrow points to the left edge). On this rotated plan, the Guard Station appears at the top of the page. In true compass terms, where is the Guard Station located on the floor?
options: At the east side
At the north side
At the south side
At the west side
questions.rationale: Because the top of the page points east on this rotated map, anything drawn at the top of the page is actually on the east side of the floor. It is not north, because north points to the left edge here. South would be the bottom and west would be the right edge on this rotation.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: A patrol loop at Everdon Prison passes six checkpoints arranged in a straight line from west to east: P1 (westmost), P2, P3, P4, P5, P6 (eastmost). The officer walks east from P1 all the way to P6, then immediately turns around and walks back west. Counting the checkpoints she newly reaches after leaving P6, which checkpoint does she reach third on the return trip?
options: P4
P2
P5
P3
questions.rationale: After turning around at P6, the checkpoints she reaches heading west are P5 (first), P4 (second), then P3 (third). P5 is only the first reached, and P4 is the second. P2 is the fourth reached, not the third.

questions.stem: The Maplewood Facility map uses a grid where north is up. The Control Center is at grid point (3,3). The Infirmary is two blocks north and one block east of the Control Center. What grid coordinates mark the Infirmary, given coordinates are written as (east, north)?
questions.rationale: Starting at (3,3), moving one block east increases the east value by 1 to 4, and moving two blocks north increases the north value by 2 to 5, giving (4,5). Option (5,4) reverses the amounts, moving too far east and not far enough north. Option (2,5) moves west instead of east. Option (4,1) moves south instead of north.

questions.stem: On the Harborview Jail floor plan, a rectangular hallway loop connects four rooms. Going clockwise starting from the top, the rooms are: Control (top), Visitation (right), Laundry (bottom), and Storage (left). An officer at Control wants the shortest walk to Laundry along the loop. Both directions cover the same number of corners. Which room will the officer pass regardless of which way they go?
options: Only Visitation
Only Storage
Neither Visitation nor Storage
Both Visitation and Storage
questions.rationale: Control and Laundry are on directly opposite sides of the rectangular loop, so each path to Laundry passes exactly one side room: going clockwise passes Visitation, and going counterclockwise passes Storage. The officer passes one or the other depending on direction, never both, and never neither. Therefore no single side room is passed regardless of direction.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: At Ridgeline Correctional, an officer stands at the main entrance facing north into the building. The Property Room is on the officer's left, and the Booking Desk is on the officer's right. Relative to true compass directions, on which side of the entrance is the Property Room?
options: East side
South side
North side
West side
questions.rationale: When facing north, the left hand points west, so the Property Room on the officer's left is on the west side. The Booking Desk on the right would be east. North is straight ahead and south is behind, neither of which is a left or right side.

questions.stem: The Stonegate housing pod has two rows of cells facing a central dayroom. The north row, left to right, is: N1, N2, N3, N4. The south row, left to right, is: S1, S2, S3, S4. Each north cell faces the south cell directly across from it, aligned by position. Which cell is directly across the dayroom from N3?
options: N2
S2
S4
S3
questions.rationale: Because cells are aligned by left-to-right position, N3 (third from the left in the north row) faces S3 (third from the left in the south row). S2 and S4 are offset by one position and sit diagonally, not directly across. N2 is in the same north row, not across the dayroom.

questions.stem: A facility map shows a straight main corridor running east-west. Branching off it are three side halls to the south, in this order from west to east: Hall A, Hall B, Hall C. The Kitchen is at the end of Hall B. An officer at the west end of the main corridor must reach the Kitchen. Which route is shortest?
options: Walk south down Hall A, then find a connector to Hall B
Walk east along the main corridor to Hall B, then south to the Kitchen
Walk east to Hall C, then back west and south into Hall B
Walk east all the way to Hall C, then south to the Kitchen
questions.rationale: The direct route goes east only as far as Hall B, then turns south to the Kitchen, covering no wasted distance. Going to Hall C first overshoots and requires backtracking west. Entering Hall A relies on an unmarked connector and is longer. Turning south at Hall C leads to the wrong hall entirely, not the Kitchen.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: On the Brookfield Detention map, the Gymnasium sits directly south of the Cafeteria, and the Library sits directly east of the Cafeteria. An officer at the Gymnasium needs to reach the Library. Ignoring interior walls, in which general direction is the Library from the Gymnasium?
options: Southeast
Southwest
Northwest
Northeast
questions.rationale: The Library is east of the Cafeteria and the Cafeteria is north of the Gymnasium, so from the Gymnasium the Library lies both north and east, which is northeast. Northwest would require the Library to be west, but it is east. Southeast and Southwest both place the Library south of the Gymnasium, but it is actually north.

questions.stem: The Fairmont Jail second floor has a square hallway loop with a room at each corner: Control (northwest), Medical (northeast), Chapel (southeast), and Classroom (southwest). An officer at Control wants the shortest path to Chapel, which is at the opposite corner. Traveling either way around the loop covers two hallway segments. Which statement is true?
options: Going by way of Medical is shorter than going by way of Classroom
Going by way of Classroom is shorter than going by way of Medical
Both routes are equal in length
There is no path between Control and Chapel
questions.rationale: Control and Chapel are at diagonally opposite corners of the square loop, so each route passes exactly one intermediate corner and covers two equal hallway segments. Because the square's sides are equal, the Medical route and the Classroom route are the same length. A path clearly exists, so the last option is false.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: An officer starts at the Sally Port and follows these directions on the facility map: walk north 2 segments, turn east and walk 1 segment, then turn south and walk 2 segments. Relative to the Sally Port, where does the officer end up?
options: Back at the Sally Port
2 segments north of the Sally Port
1 segment west of the Sally Port
1 segment east of the Sally Port
questions.rationale: The 2 segments north and 2 segments south cancel out, leaving only the 1 segment east, so the officer ends 1 segment east of the start. It is not west, since the only east-west movement was eastward. The north and south movements offset, so the officer is not 2 north, and because there was net eastward movement the officer is not back at the Sally Port.

questions.stem: In Housing Unit 4, a row of cells runs left to right: 401, 402, 403, 404, 405, 406, 407. The Officer Station is directly across the walkway from cell 404. An inmate in cell 402 is described as being 'two cells to the right' of another cell. Which cell is being referenced?
questions.rationale: If cell 402 is two cells to the right of some cell, that cell must be two positions to the left of 402, which would be 400. Cell 404 is two cells to the right of 402, not to its left. Cell 401 is only one to the left. Cell 403 is one to the right of 402, in the wrong direction.

questions.stem: The Glenmoor facility has a central atrium with four wings labeled by compass direction: North Wing, East Wing, South Wing, West Wing. The Cafeteria is in the East Wing and the Infirmary is in the North Wing. An officer in the South Wing must go to the Infirmary, then to the Cafeteria, returning through the atrium each time. From the South Wing atrium exit, which sequence of directions leads Infirmary-then-Cafeteria correctly?
options: Go south to Infirmary, return, then go west to Cafeteria
Go east to Infirmary, return, then go north to Cafeteria
Go north to Cafeteria, return, then go east to Infirmary
Go north to Infirmary, return, then go east to Cafeteria
questions.rationale: The Infirmary is in the North Wing, so the officer heads north to reach it, and the Cafeteria is in the East Wing, so the officer heads east to reach it. The second option swaps the directions for the two destinations. The third option assigns the wrong destinations to each direction. The fourth option sends the officer south and west, away from both wings.

questions.stem: A facility map shows the Control Room connected by hallways to four rooms: A is 1 segment away, B is 2 segments away, C is 1 segment away, and D is 3 segments away. Rooms A and C are each single hallways off the Control Room, while B and D require passing through other rooms. Which room can an officer reach from the Control Room by the shortest walk?
options: Only D
Either A or C
Room B, because it is central
Only B
questions.rationale: Rooms A and C are both just 1 segment from the Control Room, the smallest distance listed, so either is reachable by the shortest walk. Room B is 2 segments away and Room D is 3 segments away, both longer. Distance, not centrality, determines the shortest route, so the last option's reasoning is invalid.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: On the Ashford Jail map, an officer facing south stands at a junction. The Kitchen is behind the officer, the Laundry is to the officer's left, and the Armory is to the officer's right. In true compass terms, in which direction is the Laundry from the junction?
options: East
North
South
West
questions.rationale: When a person faces south, their left hand points east, so the Laundry on the left is to the east. The Armory on the right would be west. The Kitchen behind the south-facing officer is to the north, and south is straight ahead, so neither describes the Laundry.

questions.stem: The Denton Correctional dayroom has tables arranged in a 3-by-3 grid, numbered like a phone keypad: Table 1 is top-left, Table 5 is center, Table 9 is bottom-right, and so on. Which table is directly to the right of Table 4?
options: Table 6
Table 5
Table 7
Table 1
questions.rationale: In a keypad layout, Table 4 is in the middle-left and Table 5 is the center, directly to its right. Table 6 is two positions to the right of Table 4, not adjacent. Table 1 is above Table 4, and Table 7 is below it, neither being to the right.

questions.stem: A facility corridor runs north-south. Off it, doors are spaced evenly. From the south end heading north, the doors are: Storage (0 m), Break Room (10 m), Restroom (20 m), Locker Room (30 m). An officer at the Restroom is called to the Storage room. What is the shortest distance and direction to travel?
options: 20 meters north
30 meters south
20 meters south
10 meters south
questions.rationale: The Restroom is at 20 m and Storage is at 0 m on the corridor, a difference of 20 meters, and since Storage is at the south end the officer travels south. Traveling north would move toward the Locker Room, away from Storage. Ten meters south reaches only the Break Room, and thirty meters would overshoot the south end.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: The Vernon Facility map shows the Chapel directly across the main hallway from the Law Library. The Chapel is flanked on its left by the Classroom and on its right by the Counseling Office. Standing in the hallway facing the Chapel, which room is directly across from the Counseling Office?
options: The Law Library itself
A room to the left of the Law Library
A room to the right of the Law Library
The Classroom
questions.rationale: When you face the Chapel, the Counseling Office is on your right. Rooms across the hallway are mirrored, so the room directly across from the Counseling Office is on the opposite side, which is to the left of the Law Library from that facing viewpoint. It is not the Law Library itself, which faces the Chapel. It is not to the right, because facing rooms reverse left and right, and it is not the Classroom, which is on the same side as the Chapel.

questions.stem: An officer at the Central Control tower can reach the Yard by two routes on the facility map. Route 1 goes through the Dining Hall and covers 4 hallway segments. Route 2 goes past the Medical Unit and covers 3 hallway segments but includes one locked gate that is currently open. Which is the shortest available route to the Yard?
options: Route 2, past the Medical Unit
Route 1, through the Dining Hall
Both routes are equal
Neither route reaches the Yard
questions.rationale: Route 2 covers only 3 segments compared to Route 1's 4 segments, and the gate on Route 2 is currently open, so it is passable and shorter. Route 1 is longer at 4 segments. The two routes are not equal in length. Both routes reach the Yard, so the last option is false.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: On the Templeton Jail map, north is up. The Sally Port is in the southwest corner and the Control Room is in the northeast corner of the rectangular building. An officer walks in a straight diagonal line from the Sally Port to the Control Room. In which general compass direction is the officer heading?
options: Northwest
Southeast
Southwest
Northeast
questions.rationale: Moving from the southwest corner to the northeast corner means going both north and east, which is the northeast direction. Southeast would head down and right, but the destination is up. Northwest heads up and left, but the destination is to the right. Southwest is the opposite of the intended direction.

questions.stem: A row of holding cells is labeled H1 through H8 from left to right. The camera monitor lists them but cell H5 is out of service. An officer needs the cell immediately to the left of H5 that is still in service. Which cell is it?
options: H5
H4
H6
H3
questions.rationale: H4 is immediately to the left of H5 and is in service, making it the correct cell. H6 is to the right of H5, not the left. H3 is two cells to the left, not immediately adjacent. H5 itself is the out-of-service cell being referenced, not the answer.

questions.stem: At Harlow Detention Center, an officer plans a patrol that must visit the Kitchen, the Chapel, and the Gym, then return to the Guard Station, walking each connecting hallway only once if possible. The hallways available are: Guard Station-Kitchen, Kitchen-Chapel, Chapel-Gym, and Gym-Guard Station. Which statements about a valid single-loop patrol are TRUE?
options: The patrol requires walking at least one hallway twice
There is no possible route connecting all four locations
The route Guard Station -> Kitchen -> Chapel -> Gym -> Guard Station uses each hallway exactly once
The route forms a closed loop returning to the Guard Station
The reverse order Guard Station -> Gym -> Chapel -> Kitchen -> Guard Station is also a valid single loop
questions.rationale: The four hallways form a closed ring, so Guard Station to Kitchen to Chapel to Gym to Guard Station uses each hallway exactly once and returns to the start, making it a valid closed loop; walking it in reverse is equally valid. Because the loop covers every hallway once, no hallway must be repeated, and a route connecting all four locations clearly exists, so those two statements are false.

questions.stem: The Ironwood Correctional Facility is laid out on a grid where each block is one unit. The Control Center is at coordinates that we will call the origin. The Medical Unit is 3 units north and 2 units east of the Control Center. The Kitchen is 1 unit north and 2 units east of the Control Center. Traveling only along grid streets (north-south and east-west), what is the shortest distance in units from the Kitchen to the Medical Unit?
options: 2 units
3 units
5 units
4 units
questions.rationale: Both the Kitchen and Medical Unit are 2 units east of the Control Center, so they share the same east-west position; the only difference is north-south, where Medical is 3 units north and Kitchen is 1 unit north, a gap of 2 units. Thus the shortest grid path is simply 2 units straight north. The larger answers add unnecessary east-west travel that is not required since the east offsets are equal.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: At the Marlow Detention Center, Officer Ford walks a route: from the Control Room she goes 4 doors east down the main hall to the Armory, then turns and goes 3 doors north up a side hall to the Roof Access, then turns and goes 4 doors west along an upper hall to the Camera Room. Relative to the Control Room, in which direction and roughly how far is the Camera Room?
options: Directly east, about 4 doors away
Northeast, about 5 doors away
Directly north of the Control Room, about 3 doors away
Directly south, about 3 doors away
questions.rationale: She travels 4 doors east then later 4 doors west, canceling the east-west movement, leaving only the 3 doors north from the side hall. So the Camera Room ends up directly north of the Control Room, about 3 doors away. The east and northeast options ignore that the westward leg exactly undoes the eastward leg, and south is the wrong direction entirely.

questions.stem: The Vanguard Facility has a patrol that must hit five posts, but with constraints: the Sally Port must be first, the Armory must be checked immediately before the Yard, the Kitchen must come before the Armory, and the Infirmary must be last. The five posts are Sally Port, Kitchen, Armory, Yard, and Infirmary. Which order satisfies all the constraints?
options: Sally Port, Kitchen, Yard, Armory, Infirmary
Kitchen, Sally Port, Armory, Yard, Infirmary
Sally Port, Armory, Kitchen, Yard, Infirmary
Sally Port, Kitchen, Armory, Yard, Infirmary
questions.rationale: Only 'Sally Port, Kitchen, Armory, Yard, Infirmary' satisfies every rule: Sally Port first, Infirmary last, Kitchen before Armory, and Armory immediately before the Yard. The second option puts Armory before the Kitchen, the third separates Armory from being immediately before the Yard, and the fourth fails to put the Sally Port first.
