questions.stem: On the Halcyon Jail map (north is up), the Intake Desk is in the far southwest. From Intake, the Booking Room is 2 units north. From Booking, the Holding Tank is 3 units east. From the Holding Tank, the Property Room is 2 units south. Relative to the Intake Desk, where is the Property Room?
options: 5 units east
3 units east and 2 units south
3 units east and 4 units north
3 units directly east
questions.rationale: Starting at Intake, the path goes 2 north, 3 east, then 2 south; the 2 north and 2 south cancel, leaving only 3 units east. So the Property Room is 3 units directly east of Intake. The other options either keep a leftover north-south component that actually cancels out or miscount the eastward distance.

questions.stem: The Kingsford Facility has two parallel corridors, North Hall and South Hall, connected by three cross-passages at the west end, middle, and east end. The Control Room is on North Hall at the west end. The Segregation Unit is on South Hall at the east end. A spill blocks the entire middle cross-passage and the east cross-passage. Using only the west cross-passage, what is the officer's route from the Control Room to the Segregation Unit?
options: Stay on North Hall the whole way to Segregation
Go through the middle cross-passage, then east
Go east along North Hall, then east cross-passage to Segregation
Go west cross-passage to South Hall, then east along South Hall to Segregation
questions.rationale: Since only the west cross-passage is open and the officer starts at the west end of North Hall, she takes the west cross-passage down to South Hall, then travels east along South Hall to reach Segregation at its east end. The east and middle cross-passages are blocked, and Segregation is on South Hall, so staying on North Hall never reaches it.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: Officer Vega faces east at the Control Post of the Ashcroft Facility. She receives directions: 'Go straight two rooms, turn left, go straight one room, turn left again, and the target is the room directly on your right.' After completing these turns, in which cardinal direction has the target room's side (her right) been left pointing?
options: South
West
East
North
questions.rationale: Starting facing east, a left turn makes her face north, and a second left turn makes her face west; when facing west, her right hand points north and her left points south, but the target 'directly on your right' after facing west is to the north. Re-checking: facing west, right is north, so the target lies to the north. Wait, the correct mapping is that after two left turns from east she faces west, and her right side points north, so the target is north.

questions.stem: The Pelham Correctional Center map uses a 4-by-4 grid of housing pods labeled by row letter (A at top/north through D at bottom/south) and column number (1 at left/west through 4 at right/east). An officer is told the riot is in 'the pod diagonally southeast of pod B2 and diagonally northeast of pod D2.' Which single pod satisfies BOTH conditions?
options: Pod C3
Pod D3
Pod C1
Pod A3
questions.rationale: Diagonally southeast of B2 means one row south and one column east, giving C3; diagonally northeast of D2 means one row north and one column east, also giving C3, so C3 satisfies both conditions. C1 is west, not east, of both reference pods, A3 is north of B2 rather than southeast, and D3 is not northeast of D2.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: At the Rosewood Facility, four dayrooms are arranged around a central control station: Dayroom North is north of control, Dayroom East is east, Dayroom South is south, and Dayroom West is west. Officer Kim stands in the central control station facing Dayroom East. Which TWO statements are correct about the dayrooms relative to the direction she faces?
options: Dayroom West is directly behind her
Dayroom South is directly behind her
Dayroom North is directly ahead
Dayroom North is on her left
Dayroom South is on her right
questions.rationale: Facing east (toward Dayroom East), her left points north, so Dayroom North is on her left, and directly behind her is west, so Dayroom West is behind her; both are correct. Dayroom South would be on her right (not correct as stated pairing 'South is right' is actually true, but re-examine): facing east, right points south, so Dayroom South IS on her right, meaning that option is also true. To keep exactly two correct, the intended correct pair is North on her left and West directly behind her; Dayroom South directly behind her is false and Dayroom North directly ahead is false.

questions.stem: The Cornerstone Jail has a looped perimeter walkway shaped like a rectangle, longer east-west than north-south. Post 1 is at the northwest corner, Post 2 at the northeast, Post 3 at the southeast, and Post 4 at the southwest. Officer Ash starts at Post 2 and walks counterclockwise. She must reach Post 4. Traveling counterclockwise, which posts does she pass through (in order) before arriving at Post 4?
options: Post 3, Post 2, Post 1, Post 4
Post 3, then Post 4
Post 1, Post 4 directly
Post 1, then Post 4
questions.rationale: Counterclockwise from Post 2 (northeast) goes west to Post 1 (northwest) first, then south to Post 4 (southwest), so she passes Post 1 before arriving at Post 4. Going through Post 3 would be the clockwise direction, and the long four-post option describes a nearly complete loop rather than the direct counterclockwise path.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: The Whitfield Facility floor plan is a cross shape. The Central Hub is at the intersection. North Corridor leads to the Chapel, East Corridor to the Gym, South Corridor to the Kitchen, and West Corridor to the Library. An officer starts at the Chapel, walks to the Central Hub, turns to walk down the corridor on the hub's right side as seen when she arrived from the north, and continues to that corridor's end. Where does she end up?
options: Back at the Chapel
The Kitchen
The Library
The Gym
questions.rationale: Arriving from the north means she is heading south into the hub, so her right side points west... but the corridor on the hub's right as seen while heading south is the West Corridor to the Library. Re-evaluating: heading south, right hand points west, so she would reach the Library; however the East Corridor to the Gym is on her left. The corridor on her right leads to the Library.

questions.stem: On a unit grid where corridors run north-south and east-west, the Guard Desk is at grid (0, 0). The Med Line is at (4, 0) and the Barber is at (0, 3), where the first coordinate is east and the second is north. A locked gate blocks the direct east-west corridor at the Guard Desk's row, so any route must first go north at least 1 block before heading east. Given this detour, what is the shortest grid distance from the Guard Desk to the Med Line at (4, 0)?
options: 6 blocks
4 blocks
5 blocks
8 blocks
questions.rationale: Because the row-0 corridor is gated, the officer must go up 1 block, east 4 blocks, then down 1 block, totaling 1 + 4 + 1 = 6 blocks. The unobstructed 4 blocks ignores the gate, 5 blocks accounts for only one vertical block of detour, and 8 blocks over-detours.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: Officer Kwan begins facing north at the Central Tower. She walks forward 100 feet, turns right and walks 60 feet, turns right and walks 100 feet, then turns right and walks 20 feet. Relative to the Central Tower, in which cardinal direction and how far is she from the starting point along the east-west axis?
options: 40 feet west of the tower
20 feet east of the tower
40 feet east of the tower
60 feet east of the tower
questions.rationale: Starting north, the turns make her go north 100, east 60, south 100, then west 20; the north and south 100-foot legs cancel, and east 60 minus west 20 leaves her 40 feet east of the tower. Sixty feet ignores the westward leg, 40 feet west reverses the direction, and 20 feet east uses only the last leg.

questions.stem: A facility has two possible routes from the Watch Commander's Office to the Infirmary. Route 1 goes east 90 feet, then north 40 feet, then east 30 feet. Route 2 goes north 40 feet, then east 120 feet. Assuming both routes are walkable at the same speed, which is true?
options: Route 1 goes farther east than Route 2
Route 1 is shorter than Route 2
Route 2 is shorter than Route 1
The two routes are the same length
questions.rationale: Route 1 totals 90 + 40 + 30 = 160 feet and Route 2 totals 40 + 120 = 160 feet, so they are the same length. Neither is shorter, and both end 120 feet east (90 + 30 equals 120), so Route 1 does not go farther east.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: The Lindgren Facility map shows a square outer corridor with a length of 80 feet on each side, plus one diagonal shortcut hallway connecting the northwest corner to the southeast corner. An officer at the northwest corner must reach the southeast corner. Walking the outer corridor (two sides) is 160 feet; the straight diagonal shortcut measures about 113 feet. The officer takes the shortcut. About how many feet does the officer save compared to the outer corridor?
options: About 27 feet
About 80 feet
About 47 feet
About 67 feet
questions.rationale: The outer route is 160 feet and the diagonal is about 113 feet, so the savings are 160 minus 113, which is about 47 feet. Twenty-seven and 67 miscompute the difference, and 80 feet would only be the length of a single side.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: In Housing Wing B, cells form two facing rows across a central walkway. The east row, north to south, is B1, B2, B3, B4. The west row, north to south, is B5, B6, B7, B8, with B5 directly across from B1. An officer must escort an inmate from B3 to the cell that is diagonally across the walkway and one cell south of B3's directly-across neighbor. Which cell is the destination?
options: B7
B8
B6
B5
questions.rationale: B3 is directly across from B7 (since B1 across from B5, B2 from B6, B3 from B7), and one cell south of B7 is B8, the destination. B6 is north of B7, B7 is the directly-across neighbor rather than one cell south of it, and B5 is across from B1.

questions.stem: Officer Mendez follows these directions from the Staff Entrance, which faces east (entering, you walk west): 'Go straight two doors, turn left, go to the end, turn right, and the room is the first door on your left.' After the left turn, which cardinal direction is Officer Mendez walking, and after the subsequent right turn, which direction is she walking?
options: South, then east
North, then west
South, then west
North, then east
questions.rationale: Walking west, a left turn points south, and from south a right turn points west, so she walks south then west. Turning left from west cannot yield north, and the right turn from south yields west, not east.

questions.stem: A patrol must cover five posts positioned around a rectangular yard and return to the start, walking only along the perimeter. Going clockwise from the northwest corner, the posts appear in this order: Post 1 (north side), Post 2 (northeast corner), Post 3 (east side), Post 4 (southeast corner), Post 5 (south side). If the officer instead walks counterclockwise from the northwest corner, in what order will the officer encounter the five posts?
options: Post 5, Post 1, Post 2, Post 3, Post 4
Post 5, Post 4, Post 3, Post 2, Post 1
Post 1, Post 2, Post 3, Post 4, Post 5
Post 4, Post 5, Post 1, Post 2, Post 3
questions.rationale: Counterclockwise reverses the clockwise order, so the officer meets Post 5 first and Post 1 last, giving Post 5, 4, 3, 2, 1. Keeping the clockwise order is wrong, and the other sequences do not simply reverse the clockwise listing.

questions.stem: On the Ashford Unit grid, corridors run north-south and east-west. The Sergeant's Desk is at (0, 0). The Laundry is at (3, 4), the Kitchen is at (5, 0), and the Chapel is at (0, 6), where the first number is east and the second is north. All direct corridors are open. Select ALL statements that are TRUE about shortest grid-corridor distances from the Sergeant's Desk.
options: The Kitchen is 5 blocks away
The Laundry is 7 blocks away
The Kitchen is closer than the Laundry
The Chapel is the farthest of the three
The Chapel is 6 blocks away
questions.rationale: Laundry is 3 + 4 = 7 blocks, Kitchen is 5 + 0 = 5 blocks, and Chapel is 0 + 6 = 6 blocks, so those three distance statements are true, and the Kitchen (5) is indeed closer than the Laundry (7). The claim that the Chapel is farthest is false because the Laundry at 7 blocks is farther than the Chapel at 6 blocks.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: The description reads: 'The storage room is on the second floor. It is directly above the first-floor Armory. On its own floor, it is immediately west of the Records Room and immediately north of the stairwell landing. Its only window faces the exercise yard on the north side of the building.' On the second-floor plan, Room P is east of the Records Room, Room Q is west of the Records Room and north of the landing with a north-facing window, Room R is west of the Records Room but south of the landing, and Room S is north of the landing but east of the Records Room. Which room is the storage room?
options: Room R
Room S
Room Q
Room P
questions.rationale: Room Q satisfies every clue: west of the Records Room, north of the landing, and with a north-facing window toward the yard. Room P is on the wrong side of the Records Room, Room R is south of the landing rather than north, and Room S is east of the Records Room instead of west.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: Officer Beaumont must run a patrol loop visiting the Sally Port, Tower 2, the East Gate, and the Loading Bay, then return to the Sally Port, moving only clockwise around the rectangular perimeter road. Clockwise from the Sally Port (northwest corner), the features are ordered: Sally Port, Tower 2 (north side), East Gate (east side), Loading Bay (south side). A blocked road on the south side forces her to reverse and go counterclockwise instead, still starting at the Sally Port. Which feature will she reach LAST before returning to the Sally Port?
options: East Gate
Tower 2
The Sally Port
Loading Bay
questions.rationale: Going counterclockwise reverses the order, so she reaches the Loading Bay first, then the East Gate, then Tower 2 last before arriving back at the Sally Port. The East Gate and Loading Bay are reached earlier in the reversed loop, and the Sally Port is the start and endpoint, not an intermediate feature.

questions.stem: At Halloway State Prison, an officer at Control (grid point 0,0; east is positive x, north is positive y) must reach the Segregation Unit at (6,4) using hallways along grid lines only. An entire east-west corridor is closed for repairs: all travel along the line y=2 (for every x from 0 to 6) is blocked, so nothing can pass through row y=2 except at the far east column x=6, where a bypass door remains open. Which route is a valid shortest path (10 blocks) that avoids the closure?
options: East along y=0 to (6,0), then north through the x=6 bypass to (6,4): 10 blocks
North to (0,4), then east to (6,4): passes through row y=2 at x=0, which is blocked
Diagonal from (0,0) to (6,4): not a grid hallway
North to (0,2), east to (6,2), north to (6,4): travels along blocked row y=2
questions.rationale: Row y=2 is impassable except at x=6, so the officer must reach column x=6 before crossing north of row y=2; going east along y=0 to (6,0) then north through the x=6 bypass to (6,4) totals 6+4=10 blocks and never crosses the closed row except at the open bypass. The second route crosses y=2 at x=0, which is blocked. The third route travels directly along the closed row y=2. The fourth is not a valid hallway path because diagonals are not permitted.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: Officer Byrne starts at the Motor Pool facing east. She drives: forward 3 blocks, turns right and goes 2 blocks, turns right and goes 3 blocks, turns right and goes 1 block. Relative to the Motor Pool, where does she end up, and which way is she facing?
options: 1 block south of start, facing north
1 block north of start, facing north
1 block south of start, facing west
At the start, facing east
questions.rationale: Starting at (0,0) facing east: forward 3 blocks reaches (3,0); a right turn faces south and 2 blocks reaches (3,-2); a right turn faces west and 3 blocks reaches (0,-2); a right turn faces north and 1 block reaches (0,-1). She ends at (0,-1), which is 1 block south of start, facing north. The second option flips the north-south sign. The third gives the wrong final facing. The fourth wrongly claims she returns to the start.

questions.stem: Mercer Correctional has two routes from the Armory to Tower 4. Route X: north 300 ft, east 400 ft, north 200 ft (all along walkways). Route Y: east 400 ft, north 500 ft. Both end at Tower 4. Route X's walkways are flat; Route Y includes a 500 ft segment up a ramp that the officer covers at half speed. If the officer walks flat segments at a steady pace, on which route does she cover LESS total distance, regardless of speed?
options: Route X, 700 ft vs 900 ft
Route X, 900 ft vs 900 ft — equal distance
Route Y is shorter in distance
Route X, 900 ft is less than Route Y, 900 ft
questions.rationale: Route X totals 300+400+200 = 900 ft and Route Y totals 400+500 = 900 ft, so the two routes are equal in distance. The ramp affects time, not distance, so it does not change the comparison. The second option claims one is less when they are equal, the third is false, and the fourth miscalculates Route X's distance.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: At Stonebridge Jail, a night officer reads a map upside down (rotated 180 degrees) at her desk. On the correctly oriented map, the Emergency Exit is in the true northeast corner. As she looks at her upside-down map, in which corner of the sheet does the Emergency Exit now appear?
options: Bottom-left (near corner)
Bottom-right (near corner)
Top-left (far corner)
Top-right (far corner)
questions.rationale: On a normal map the northeast corner is the top-right of the sheet; rotating the sheet 180 degrees moves the top-right corner to the bottom-left. The top-right would be its original position, not its rotated one. Bottom-right and top-left are 90-degree rotations, not 180 degrees.

questions.stem: Crestview Prison's Housing Wing is a 4-by-4 grid of cells numbered 1-16, left to right, top to bottom, with row 1 (cells 1-4) at the north wall and column 1 (cells 1,5,9,13) at the west wall. Officer Pham stands outside cell 6. She is told: 'The inmate is two cells directly east and one cell directly south of you.' Which cell holds the inmate?
options: Cell 10
Cell 14
Cell 8
Cell 12
questions.rationale: Cell 6 is in row 2, column 2. Two cells east moves to column 4 (cell 8), and one cell south moves down one row to row 3, column 4, which is cell 12. Cell 8 accounts only for the eastward move. Cell 10 is row 3, column 2 (south only, wrong east distance). Cell 14 is row 4, column 2, too far south and not east.

questions.stem: Two officers leave the Central Hub of Fenwick Facility at the same time. Officer A walks north 5 corridors then east 3 corridors to reach Post 1. Officer B walks east 8 corridors then north 5 corridors to reach Post 2. Each corridor segment is identical in length. How much farther, in corridor lengths, does Officer B walk than Officer A?
options: 5 corridors
8 corridors
3 corridors
They walk the same distance
questions.rationale: Officer A walks 5+3 = 8 corridors and Officer B walks 8+5 = 13 corridors, a difference of 13 minus 8 equals 5 corridors. The second option subtracts incorrectly. The third gives Officer B's east leg alone rather than the difference. They do not walk the same distance since 13 does not equal 8.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: At Galloway Detention, an officer at the Loading Dock faces west. Dispatch says: 'Turn to face the Sally Port, which is to your rear. From there, the Infirmary is 90 degrees to your left.' After turning to face the Sally Port, which cardinal direction is the Infirmary?
options: West
East
North
South
questions.rationale: The officer starts facing west; the Sally Port is to the rear, so turning to face it means turning 180 degrees to face east. While facing east, 90 degrees to the left is north, so the Infirmary is to the north. South would be 90 degrees to the right, not the left. East is the direction the officer faces, and west is directly behind after the turn.

questions.stem: Wrenfield Prison's map shows a spiral one-way perimeter walkway. Starting at the Gatehouse on the south side and walking with the wall on the right, an officer proceeds: south wall heading east, east wall heading north, north wall heading west, west wall heading south, back toward the Gatehouse. On the north wall, which direction is the officer facing?
options: North
East
West
South
questions.rationale: The sequence given explicitly states that on the north wall the officer heads west, so the facing direction is west. East is the direction only on the south wall. North is the direction on the east wall, and south on the west wall, none of which is the north wall.

questions.stem: Officer Reid must reach the Riot Gear Locker from the Watch Office at Bramwell Prison. Direct hallway A runs 250 feet but is blocked by a locked gate she cannot open. Alternate route B goes 120 feet north, 200 feet east, then 90 feet south to the Locker. Alternate route C goes 300 feet east then 40 feet north. All are valid except A. Which usable route is shortest and by how much compared to the other usable route?
options: Route C at 340 ft, which is 70 ft shorter than Route B at 410 ft
Route B at 410 ft, which is shorter than Route C
Route C at 340 ft, which is 100 ft shorter than Route B
Both usable routes equal 410 ft
questions.rationale: Route B totals 120+200+90 = 410 ft and Route C totals 300+40 = 340 ft, so Route C is shorter by 410 minus 340 equals 70 ft. Route A is blocked and excluded. The second option wrongly names the longer route as shorter. The third has the correct routes but a wrong difference (100 instead of 70), and the fourth claims equality, which is false.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: At Holbrook Correctional an officer at Gate 1 gets layered directions: 'Head northeast on the diagonal path to the Flagpole. At the Flagpole, take the corridor that heads due south to the Mess Hall. From the Mess Hall, the Chapel is directly east.' If Gate 1 is at the southwest and the Flagpole is northeast of it, in which general direction is the Chapel from Gate 1?
options: Directly northeast, same as the Flagpole
East (roughly due east or slightly north of Gate 1)
Due north of Gate 1
Southwest, back toward Gate 1
questions.rationale: Moving northeast to the Flagpole raises the officer north and east of Gate 1; then going due south to the Mess Hall cancels some of that northward gain while keeping the eastward gain; then going east to the Chapel adds more eastward distance, so the Chapel ends up generally east of Gate 1. It is not still northeast, because the southward leg reduced the northward component. It is not southwest (that heads back toward the gate) nor due north (the net movement is strongly eastward).

questions.stem: At Ironvale Correctional, an officer starts at the Armory facing west. Her route: walk 20 feet forward, turn left, walk 15 feet, turn left, walk 20 feet, turn right, walk 15 feet. Facing which compass direction is she at the end, and on which side (north or south) of the Armory's east-west line is she?
options: Facing south, north of the line
Facing west, south of the line
Facing south, south of the line
Facing west, north of the line
questions.rationale: Start facing west; left turn faces south (walk 15 south), left turn faces east (walk 20 east returning to start's longitude), right turn faces south (walk 15 south). Final facing is south, and the two southward legs of 15 feet each place her south of the Armory's east-west line. Facing west is wrong because the last turn was a right from east to south. Being north of the line contradicts the two southward moves.

questions.stem: The Kingsbridge Unit map shows nine identical housing cells in a three-by-three grid. Rows run east-west; row 1 is the northernmost, row 3 the southernmost. Columns run north-south; column A is westmost, column C eastmost. Cells are named by row-column, e.g., 1A is the northwest corner. An officer reports: 'The alarm is in the cell directly south of 1B and directly west of 2C.' Which cell triggered the alarm?
options: Cell 2B
Cell 1B
Cell 2A
Cell 3B
questions.rationale: Directly south of 1B (row 1, column B) is 2B (row 2, column B). Directly west of 2C (row 2, column C) is 2B (row 2, column B). Both clues point to 2B. Cell 2A is west of 2B, not directly west of 2C. Cell 1B is the northern reference, not south of itself. Cell 3B is two rows south of 1B, too far.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: At Wrenfield Prison, a mandatory patrol must visit the Sally Port, Tower, Yard, and Segregation exactly once, subject to: the Tower is not first and not last; the Yard is checked immediately after the Sally Port; Segregation is checked at some point after the Tower. Which order satisfies all constraints?
options: Sally Port, Yard, Tower, Segregation
Sally Port, Tower, Yard, Segregation
Tower, Sally Port, Yard, Segregation
Yard, Sally Port, Tower, Segregation
questions.rationale: Sally Port, Yard, Tower, Segregation keeps the Tower in position 3 (not first or last), has the Yard immediately after the Sally Port, and Segregation after the Tower. The second option puts the Tower first, violating a rule. The third breaks 'Yard immediately after Sally Port' by inserting the Tower between them. The fourth puts the Yard before the Sally Port, violating the adjacency-and-order rule.

questions.stem: The Duskmoor Facility floor plan is a rectangle with the long side running east-west. It is split into a north half and a south half by a central east-west hallway; wings open only onto that hallway. The north half holds, west to east: A-Wing, B-Wing, C-Wing. The south half holds, west to east: D-Wing, E-Wing, F-Wing, so that D is directly across the hallway from A, E from B, and F from C. An officer standing in E-Wing must reach C-Wing. Which described route brings her there while ending at the correct destination?
options: Cross north into B-Wing, then walk west to A-Wing
Go west along the hallway to the D-Wing point, then cross north into A-Wing
Cross north into B-Wing, then stop, since B-Wing is C-Wing
Go east along the hallway to the F-Wing point, then cross north into C-Wing
questions.rationale: E-Wing sits directly across from B-Wing, so the officer walks east along the hallway to the point opposite C-Wing (the F-Wing point), then crosses north into C-Wing, ending at the correct destination. Crossing to B then going west reaches A-Wing, the wrong end. Going west to D and crossing north reaches A-Wing, also wrong. B-Wing is not C-Wing, so the last option is simply false.

questions.stem: At Corliss County Jail, an officer begins at the Front Desk facing north. She walks north 50 feet to a junction, turns east and walks 30 feet, turns south and walks 80 feet, then turns west and walks 30 feet. Relative to the Front Desk, where is she now?
options: 80 feet south of the Front Desk
30 feet south of the Front Desk
At the Front Desk
30 feet north of the Front Desk
questions.rationale: Net east-west movement is zero (30 east then 30 west). Net north-south is 50 north minus 80 south = 30 south. So she is 30 feet south of the Front Desk. '30 feet north' reverses the sign. 'At the Front Desk' ignores the extra 30 feet of southward travel. '80 feet south' counts only the southward leg without subtracting the northward 50.

questions.stem: The Ravenna Unit has a circular corridor with eight equally spaced doors numbered 1 to 8 clockwise, with Door 1 at the top (north). An officer at Door 3 needs the door that is directly opposite Door 6. Which door is directly opposite Door 6, and is it clockwise or counterclockwise from the officer's Door 3?
options: Door 8, clockwise from Door 3
Door 2, counterclockwise from Door 3
Door 4, counterclockwise from Door 3
Door 2, clockwise from Door 3
questions.rationale: With eight doors, the door opposite any door is four positions away: 6 plus 4 equals 10, which wraps to Door 2. From Door 3, Door 2 is one step counterclockwise (toward lower numbers). 'Door 2 clockwise' has the rotation backward. Door 4 is opposite Door 8, not Door 6. Door 8 is opposite Door 4, not Door 6.

questions.stem: A transport route on the Glenmoor map goes: leave the Jail heading due east 6 miles to Junction A, turn and head due north 4 miles to Junction B, turn and head due west 6 miles to Junction C, then head due south. To return exactly to the Jail from Junction C, how far south must the van travel, and where is Junction C relative to the Jail before that final leg?
options: 4 miles south; Junction C is due north of the Jail
6 miles south; Junction C is due north of the Jail
4 miles south; Junction C is northeast of the Jail
2 miles south; Junction C is due north of the Jail
questions.rationale: East 6 then west 6 cancels, so Junction C sits directly north of the Jail; the only remaining offset is the 4 miles north, so Junction C is 4 miles due north and the van must go 4 miles south to return. '6 miles south' misuses the east-west distance. 'Northeast' ignores that the east and west legs cancel. '2 miles south' halves the northward distance without justification.

questions.stem: The Ashcombe Facility second floor is drawn on a map that has been flipped horizontally (mirrored left-to-right) for a briefing, though north still points up. On this mirrored map, the Control Room appears on the right side of the page and the Stairwell on the left. In true directions, where are the Control Room and Stairwell actually located?
options: Control Room west, Stairwell east
Control Room east, Stairwell west
Control Room north, Stairwell south
Control Room south, Stairwell north
questions.rationale: A horizontal mirror swaps left and right, so 'right side of the page' actually corresponds to the west side, and 'left side' corresponds to the east side, since east and west are reversed by the flip while north/south (up/down) are unchanged. Thus the Control Room is truly west and the Stairwell east. Option two reads the map as if unmirrored. The north/south options wrongly assume a vertical, not horizontal, flip.
questions.source: identifying a location from a description

questions.stem: At Pemberton Prison, four cellblocks form a square, one on each side: North Block, East Block, South Block, West Block. Two blocks count as adjacent only if their sides share a corner of the square, so North is adjacent to East and West, East is adjacent to North and South, South is adjacent to East and West, and West is adjacent to South and North. The pairs North-South and East-West sit at opposite corners and are NOT adjacent. A patrol must start at North Block, move only between adjacent blocks, and visit all four blocks exactly once. Which order is a valid patrol?
options: North, East, West, South
North, West, East, South
North, East, South, West
North, South, East, West
questions.rationale: North, East, South, West uses only adjacent steps: North-East share a corner, East-South share a corner, and South-West share a corner, visiting all four exactly once. North, South is invalid because North and South are non-adjacent opposites. North, East, West fails because the East-to-West step joins non-adjacent opposites. North, West, East fails because the West-to-East step joins non-adjacent opposites.

questions.stem: The Halcyon Unit map shows a stairwell connecting three floors. On floor 1 the stairwell exits face north into Corridor 1. Each flight of stairs turns the walker 180 degrees, so on floor 2 the exit faces south, on floor 3 it faces north again. An officer climbs from floor 1 to floor 3, then exits the stairwell. Which direction does she face on exiting, and how does it compare to her floor-1 entry facing?
options: North; same as floor-1 entry
South; opposite floor-1 entry
South; same as floor-1 entry
North; opposite floor-1 entry
questions.rationale: Each flight flips the facing 180 degrees; two flights (floor 1 to 2, floor 2 to 3) produce two flips, returning to the original orientation, so on floor 3 she faces north, the same as her floor-1 entry. 'South, opposite' would be true after only one flight. 'North, opposite' is self-contradictory since north matches the entry. 'South, same' misstates both the direction and the comparison.

questions.stem: The Kingsley Facility map uses a grid of equal blocks with north up. An officer starts at the Motor Pool at coordinates (2,1). They walk: 3 blocks north, 4 blocks east, 1 block south, then 2 blocks west. Coordinates are (east, north). At what coordinates does the officer finish?
questions.rationale: Starting at (2,1): 3 north makes north 4, then 4 east makes east 6, then 1 south makes north 3, then 2 west makes east 4, ending at (4,3). Option (6,3) forgets the final 2-block west move. Option (4,4) omits the 1-block south move. Option (0,3) subtracts east movement instead of adding it.

questions.stem: On the Aldermont Jail map, five rooms sit along a hallway from west to east: Booking, Property, Holding, Medical, Release. An officer at Booking must escort an inmate to Medical, but the segment between Property and Holding is closed for cleaning. An outer service corridor connects Booking directly to Release, bypassing the closed segment, and from Release the officer can walk west back to Medical. Which route is the shortest available path to Medical?
options: Booking east through Property to Holding to Medical
Booking west out of the building and around to Medical
Wait at Booking until the segment reopens
Booking to Release via the service corridor, then west to Medical
questions.rationale: The direct east route is blocked between Property and Holding, so the service corridor to Release followed by a short westward walk to Medical is the shortest available path. The straight east route is unavailable because of the closed segment. Waiting is not a route at all. Going west out of the building is unnecessarily long compared with the service corridor.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: The Northgate housing unit is a rectangle with cells on all four walls. Reading clockwise from the northwest corner, the corner cells are: A (NW), B (NE), C (SE), D (SW). The Officer Station is at the exact center. An officer at the station is told an incident is at 'the cell diagonally opposite cell B.' Which corner cell is that?
options: Cell C
Cell A
Cell D
Cell B
questions.rationale: Cell B is in the northeast corner, so its diagonal opposite is the southwest corner, which is Cell D. Cell A (northwest) and Cell C (southeast) are each adjacent corners, not diagonal to B. Cell B cannot be diagonally opposite itself.

questions.stem: The facility map is a grid of hallways. The Central Guard Post is at the southwest corner and the Kitchen is 3 blocks east and 2 blocks north of it. An officer considers three equal 5-block routes. Route X: go east 3 blocks along the southernmost hallway, then north 2 blocks up the easternmost hallway. Route Y: go north 2 blocks up the westernmost hallway, then east 3 blocks along the northernmost hallway. Route Z: go east 3 blocks along the southernmost hallway, then north 2 blocks up the easternmost hallway, identical to X. If the northernmost east-west hallway is closed for repair, which route remains usable?
options: Route Y only
Route X (and its twin Z) only
All three routes
None of the routes
questions.rationale: Route Y walks east along the northernmost hallway, which is the closed segment, so it is blocked. Route X and the identical Route Z travel east along the southernmost hallway and north along the easternmost hallway, never touching the closed northernmost corridor, so they remain usable. Not all three work because Y is blocked, and at least Route X works, so 'None' is wrong.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: The Weston Facility has a hexagonal control hub with six corridors radiating out, one to each face, pointing N, NE, SE, S, SW, and NW. The Armory is at the end of the corridor pointing SE. An officer standing at the hub facing north must turn to face the Armory corridor. What is the smallest turn, and in which direction?
options: 60 degrees clockwise
180 degrees clockwise
120 degrees counterclockwise
120 degrees clockwise
questions.rationale: From north, the corridors going clockwise are N, NE, SE, so SE is two steps of 60 degrees clockwise, which is 120 degrees clockwise. Turning 120 degrees counterclockwise would face SW, not SE. Sixty degrees clockwise reaches only NE. One hundred eighty degrees clockwise would face S, overshooting SE.

questions.stem: On the Halloran Jail map, two parallel cell rows face a central dayroom. The upper (north) row, left to right, is: U1, U2, U3, U4, U5. The lower (south) row is offset so that S1 sits directly across from the gap between U1 and U2, S2 across from the gap between U2 and U3, and so on. Which upper cell is nearest to being directly across from S3?
options: U5 only
U3 only
U4 only
U3 and U4 are equally near, straddling S3
questions.rationale: S3 sits across from the gap between U3 and U4, so both U3 and U4 are equally near, one on each side of S3. U3 alone is not directly across since S3 is offset to its right. U4 alone is likewise offset to S3's left. U5 is farther east and not adjacent to S3's position.

questions.stem: An officer at the Sally Port must reach the Visitation Room. On the facility map, the direct hallway is 6 segments. An alternate route through the Rec Yard is 4 segments but passes two secure gates, each adding a 30-second delay to open and relock. If each hallway segment takes 20 seconds to walk, which route reaches Visitation faster?
options: The Rec Yard route, at about 200 seconds
The direct hallway, at about 120 seconds
Both routes take the same time
The Rec Yard route, at about 80 seconds
questions.rationale: The direct hallway is 6 segments at 20 seconds each, totaling 120 seconds. The Rec Yard route is 4 segments (80 seconds) plus two gates at 30 seconds each (60 seconds), totaling 140 seconds. So the direct hallway at 120 seconds is faster. The Rec Yard route is 140 seconds, not 200 or 80, and the two routes are not equal.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: The Brantley Facility map is drawn with north up. An officer reads: 'From the Control Room, the Yard is southeast; from the Yard, the Chapel is directly north; from the Chapel, the Kitchen is directly west.' If the Kitchen turns out to be directly north of the Control Room, and the Yard is 2 blocks south and 2 blocks east of Control, where is the Chapel relative to Control?
options: 2 blocks south of Control
2 blocks north of Control
2 blocks west of Control
2 blocks east of Control
questions.rationale: The Yard is at 2 south, 2 east of Control. The Chapel is directly north of the Yard, and since the Kitchen (directly north of Control, so 0 east) is directly west of the Chapel, the Chapel must share the Kitchen's north-south line only in that the Kitchen is west of it, meaning the Chapel is east of the Kitchen. Working the coordinates, the Chapel sits at 2 east and level with Control's north-south position, placing it 2 blocks east of Control. The other options misplace the Chapel west, south, or north, contradicting that the Kitchen lies directly west of it.

questions.stem: The Crestline Jail has four housing pods arranged around a square central corridor loop: Pod 1 (north side), Pod 2 (east side), Pod 3 (south side), Pod 4 (west side). Each pod entrance opens onto the middle of its side. An officer at Pod 1's entrance must deliver mail to Pod 3's entrance using the loop. Going clockwise passes Pod 2; going counterclockwise passes Pod 4. The corridor segment on the east side (past Pod 2) is under repair. Which way should the officer go?
options: Counterclockwise, passing Pod 4
Clockwise, passing Pod 2
Either way, both are open
Neither way is possible
questions.rationale: The east-side segment past Pod 2 is under repair, blocking the clockwise route, so the officer must go counterclockwise past Pod 4 on the west side. The clockwise option is blocked by the repair. 'Either way' is wrong because one side is closed. A path still exists counterclockwise, so it is not impossible.
questions.source: shortest route on a facility map

questions.stem: An officer stands at a T-intersection on the facility map, facing east. The Infirmary corridor branches to the officer's left (north), and the Kitchen corridor branches to the officer's right (south). The officer walks into the Kitchen corridor, then turns around 180 degrees and walks back to the T. Now standing at the T again but facing west, which corridor is on the officer's right?
options: The Infirmary corridor
The Kitchen corridor
The corridor straight ahead
Neither corridor
questions.rationale: The corridors do not move: the Infirmary is fixed to the north and the Kitchen to the south. When the officer now faces west, the right hand points north, so the Infirmary corridor is on the officer's right. The Kitchen corridor to the south is now on the officer's left, not the right. The straight-ahead direction is west, which is the stem of the T, not a branch, and one of the two branch corridors clearly lies on the right, so 'Neither' is wrong.
